issues.title: Google Places content on a non-Google map
issues.description: Google's terms restrict displaying Places content on non-Google maps. Verified coordinates are shown on OpenStreetMap, because the only Google key is a server-side secret that must not reach the browser.
issues.impact: Possible terms issue for commercial use. No user-visible defect.
issues.followUp: Get a browser-restricted Maps JavaScript key and use Google Maps, or use a non-Google geocoder for pins. Review the terms.

issues.title: Places dominates API cost
issues.description: Each verified stop is a $0.035 lookup, against about $0.0005 per LLM call. Measured: $4.91 of $4.94 in production. A 5-day plan with 25 uncached stops is about $0.88.
issues.impact: Spend grows quickly with traffic. The $25 daily cap would be reached at roughly 28 such plans, after which AI requests pause for everyone.
issues.followUp: Verify lazily when a stop is opened, or request a cheaper field mask without hours and ratings. Tune the cap before launch.

issues.title: Bootstrap window on a fresh deployment
issues.description: Until the password is changed, anyone who knows the documented default could complete the forced change first. This is inherent to the required admin/admin bootstrap.
issues.impact: On this deployment, closed within minutes of first going live. Applies again to any new database.
issues.followUp: Run scripts/activate-admin.mjs as part of provisioning.

issues.title: Long-distance drag not confirmed
issues.description: Dragging a stop from the bottom to the top of a long day did not reorder under Playwright, which may be a limit of its synthetic drag rather than the app. Adjacent drag passes. Touch drag is not implemented.
issues.impact: Arrow buttons and the Day field in Edit work on all devices.
issues.followUp: Test by hand, and add an accessible reorder library if it reproduces.

issues.title: Model output quality varies
issues.description: gpt-4o-mini sometimes writes pseudo-stops such as "Travel to Ryoan-ji", overly optimistic costs, or coordinates tens of km off. Unmatched stops keep those coordinates, shown as dashed approximate pins.
issues.impact: Occasional awkward stops. All are labeled and editable.
issues.followUp: Filter transport stops, or try a stronger model through LLM_MODEL (add a rate in Settings).

issues.title: Google place types can look odd
issues.description: Google labeled tofu restaurants in Kyoto as "Korean Restaurant" in one result. The label is shown as Google returned it.
issues.followUp: Hide the type label on cards if this proves common.

issues.title: Email address cannot be changed
issues.description: Account settings cover name, default currency and password.
issues.impact: Users must contact support, and no support route exists.
issues.followUp: Add a re-verified email change flow.

issues.title: Disconnect during generation
issues.description: If the browser disconnects, the Worker has only a short grace period to finish. Completed days of a first build are saved. The trip lock clears on completion or within 3 minutes.
issues.impact: A rare lost reply, and possibly a brief "still working" state.
issues.followUp: Move generation to a Cloudflare Workflow or Durable Object.

issues.title: Fixed-window rate limits
issues.description: Counters reset on window boundaries, so a burst across a boundary can reach about twice a limit. The cost cap is checked when a request starts, so it can overshoot slightly.
issues.followUp: Use sliding windows if abuse appears.

issues.title: Admin login limit counts successes
issues.description: Five login attempts per 15 minutes per address and username includes successful ones. This was hit during testing.
issues.impact: An administrator logging in repeatedly can wait up to 15 minutes.
issues.followUp: Count only failures if this is a nuisance.

issues.title: OpenStreetMap public tiles
issues.description: The public tile servers are not intended for heavy use.
issues.impact: Tiles could be throttled under real traffic.
issues.followUp: Switch to a commercial tile provider.

issues.title: Test data in production
issues.description: Verification left guest trips and test accounts in production, which appear in the dashboard and cost totals. Test accounts use disposable inbox addresses.
issues.impact: Totals include about $4.94 of test usage.
issues.followUp: Delete them under Users, or clear the tables before launch.

issues.title: CJK glyphs in test screenshots
issues.description: Headless Chromium on this machine has no CJK fonts, so some Japanese address text appeared as boxes. Real devices should fall back to system fonts, but this was not checked.
issues.impact: Expected to affect only this test environment.
